items.stem: Source pages have an immutable page_id and a slug that changes on rename. What should the Glean document ID be?

options.text: The slug, because it is readable
The immutable page_id
The page title
A hash of the page body

items.stem: Where should a production connector keep document state and checkpoints?

options.text: In a simple database the connector owns
In memory, rebuilt from scratch on each run
Nowhere; Glean stores it for the connector
In the viewURL of each document

items.stem: The source has 40 roles that grant read access to spaces. How should they be modeled?

options.text: Flattened into user lists on each document
As allowAnonymousAccess on role spaces
As custom metadata on each document
As groups with memberships

items.stem: A page requires membership in both the pharmacist group and the clinic group. How is it mapped?

options.text: Both groups listed in allowedGroups
Two separate intersection entries
One intersection entry that contains both groups
Only the clinic group, since it is narrower

items.stem: During a full crawl, the source returns an empty page with no cursor well before the expected total. What should the connector do?

options.text: Finalize, because the cursor has ended
Raise an error and leave the full run unfinalized
Retry that page once, then finalize whatever it has
Finalize and rely on the 20% safeguard

items.stem: What does an incremental crawl need before it is correct rather than merely faster?

options.text: A durable checkpoint and a reliable deletion signal
A shorter schedule than the full run
A larger batch size
Bulk uploads on every run

items.stem: When should an incremental connector write its checkpoint?

options.text: Write the current time when the first page is fetched
Write the end time even if the run failed
Never; the SDK persists it automatically
Record the start time before the crawl; write it only after success

items.stem: The source rate-limits aggressively. What retry setting does SDK guidance suggest?

options.text: Keep the default of one retry
Retry every status code, including 400 and 404
Raise max_attempts to 4 or 5, with a rate limiter
Retry forever until the source recovers

items.stem: A datasource configuration call times out. You cannot tell whether it succeeded. What do you do?

options.text: Repeat the write until it returns success
Read the configuration back and compare it
Delete the datasource and recreate it
Ignore it and start uploading

items.stem: Where should the source API key and indexing token live in production?

options.text: In a secret store, with the workload granted exact access
In the repository's config file
In exception messages for easier debugging
In the container image

items.stem: Which alert catches a partial full crawl earliest?

options.text: The job's exit status alone
CPU use on the connector host
A weekly manual dashboard review
documents_indexed dropping sharply between runs
